name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialist sub-brands (Profusion for data analytics, Amplify Analytix for customer intelligence) targeting financial services with GenAI-powered analytics. Their methodology centers on AI-driven customer segmentation, propensity modeling, and next-best-action frameworks for banking and insurance. Delivery model combines offshore India development capacity with EU-based consulting. Thought leadership focuses on practical AI deployment for customer intelligence rather than broad CX strategy.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta's methodology uniquely bridges SAP operational data with Qualtrics experience management through embedded analytics and custom UI/UX layers within SAP environments. Their AI approach leverages SAP BTP and Qualtrics AI agents to operationalize experience data within existing enterprise workflows. Delivery model is DACH-centric consulting with deep SAP technical expertise. Thought leadership themes center on reducing time-to-insight by embedding CX analytics directly into SAP process flows for manufacturing and financial services decision-makers.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics specializes in public sector and government CX transformation across the GCC, with deep expertise in Qualtrics platform implementation for citizen experience programs. Their methodology emphasizes CX maturity assessments, journey mapping for government services, and VoC program design aligned to national digital transformation visions. Delivery model is regionally embedded with offices in Saudi Arabia and UAE. Thought leadership themes focus on citizen experience benchmarking, Arabic-language survey design, and CX ROI for government digital services.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX combines large-scale research capabilities with proprietary CX measurement frameworks and Medallia platform expertise. Their methodology emphasizes statistically rigorous experience measurement, CX-to-ROI linkage models, and competitive benchmarking across industries. Their AI approach integrates predictive analytics and text analytics within broader research-driven CX programs. Thought leadership themes center on loyalty economics, customer expectations research, and sector-specific CX benchmarks for retail, financial services, and telecommunications.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont positions as a Qualtrics-specialized implementation and strategy partner with deep expertise in banking and financial services CX programs. Their methodology combines Qualtrics platform technical implementation with strategic CX program design, emphasizing AI agent deployment and experience orchestration. Delivery model is US-focused with enterprise financial services as core vertical. Thought leadership themes include Qualtrics AI feature adoption, XM program maturity, closed-loop feedback optimization, and financial services regulatory compliance in CX.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner historically focused on enterprise XM program implementation across UK and European markets. Their methodology has traditionally emphasized Qualtrics technical deployment, dashboard design, and program governance. The extended absence of new content makes current strategic positioning difficult to assess. Previous thought leadership themes included Qualtrics best practices, EX and CX program design, and public sector experience management.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap positions as a platform-agnostic CX and EX consulting firm specializing in customer journey design, employee experience transformation, and organizational change management. Their methodology emphasizes human-centered journey mapping, experience-driven culture change, and linking EX to CX outcomes. Delivery model is consulting-led across Spain and Latin America with no visible technology platform dependency. Thought leadership themes center on journey economics, experience-driven organizational transformation, and the EX-CX connection.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo is one of the largest CX consultancies in the Spanish-speaking world, operating across 15+ markets in Iberoamerica with Qualtrics certification. Their methodology combines strategic CX consulting with VoC program design, journey mapping, and CX maturity assessment. Delivery model leverages regional presence across Spain and Latin America with local market expertise. Thought leadership themes include CX strategy frameworks, digital experience optimization, customer loyalty programs, and sector-specific CX transformation for banking and telecommunications.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital-native company with CX capabilities housed within its Connected Experiences Studio alongside broader AI, engineering, and digital transformation practices. Their methodology emphasizes AI-first digital experience design at enterprise scale, integrating generative AI into customer-facing experiences and internal operations. Delivery model leverages massive global engineering capacity with nearshore Latin American talent. CX thought leadership is embedded within broader AI transformation narratives rather than standalone CX methodology content, positioning experience design as a component of holistic digital reinvention.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.

name: Acceleration Strategy
blog_profile: Acceleration Strategy is a Canada/US-based Qualtrics partner specializing in XM program strategy, Qualtrics platform implementation, and AI-driven experience optimization. Their methodology emphasizes strategic XM program design, Qualtrics AI agent deployment, experience orchestration, and data-driven CX program governance. Delivery model is North American-focused with deep Qualtrics ecosystem expertise. Thought leadership themes include Qualtrics AI feature adoption, post-X4 product analysis, experience orchestration frameworks, and enterprise XM program maturity optimization.
